data.one_liner: Provides skeleton placeholder widgets for loading states in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a set of ready‑made skeleton widgets (list view, avatar, paragraph, etc.) that can be shown while real content is loading. It also includes a theme to configure shimmer gradients globally.
use_when: You need lightweight loading placeholders that match your UI layout
You want a quick way to add shimmer‑style skeletons without writing custom painters
avoid_when: You require complex animated placeholders beyond basic skeleton shapes
You need a full‑featured skeleton library with built‑in data fetching integration
strengths: Simple API and easy to drop into existing code
weaknesses: Limited to skeleton widgets only, no advanced animation options
No code generation or integration with state‑management solutions

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level shimmer effect that can be combined with custom placeholders if you need more control
